contexts.text: There rose up from the Lower Earth as it were a volume... They were rustics and other simple ones. Described. SE 3531.

Some from the nautical and rustic crowd... appeared to have so little life that I thought it impossible for them to receive eternal life like other Spirits, being like machines, little animated; but the Angels had care for them solicitously, and through the faculty which they possessed as men, insinuated into them the life of good and truth...
Such as rustics are wont to make a sound with.

I have spoken with those who were of the rustic race... who had believed in God, and had done what is just and right in their works. Being in the affection of knowing truth, they asked what charity and what faith is... They understood well, and rejoiced, and said that they had not comprehended that to believe was anything else than to live.
Many of those (who personated old men) were of the rustic race, who... having some wealth, were proud...
Can be seen even by a rustic.
You have spoken from rustic things rustically.
A low rustic may be together with eminent persons (in that prison).
A husbandman is there surrounded with rustic things.
